meta.title: Majed
meta.description: Bidirectional (RTL/LTR) text support for Arabic, Persian and Hebrew, GenUI RTL mirroring, and extra Settings > General options such as an app-UI font size.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions (Majed)
subscriptions.unreachable: The Subscriptions host component cannot be reached. Reconnect or check the component on the Plugins page.
subscriptions.coexistence: The reference plugin dsh-plugin-subscriptions is running too. Only one plugin can serve the shared provider ids (codex, claude, grok, copilot, antigravity) at a time; switch the reference plugin off before using providers from this component.
subscriptions.creditsUnavailable: Reset credits could not be verified.
subscriptions.confirmLogout: Log this account out? Its stored credentials will be removed.
subscriptions.resetAcknowledge: I understand that one credit will be consumed.
subscriptions.providerUnavailable: Codex unavailable: provider id already registered.
subscriptions.clientVersionHint: Requests present this CLI version, and newer models may require a recent one.
subscriptions.manualSummary: Browser flow not working? Paste the callback URL or code
subscriptions.addAccountHint: Browser authorization signs in whichever account the browser currently uses — switch accounts there first (or use an incognito window with the manual code below) to add a different one.
subscriptions.resetGuard: You can use this reset when weekly usage reaches at least 80%.
subscriptions.resetRefresh: Refresh usage to verify current limits and reset availability.
subscriptions.resetReady: Use this reset — the earliest-expiring credit. Confirmation required.
subscriptions.resetWarning: This consumes one credit and resets weekly + 5-hour limits. This interface cannot undo it. Confirmation expires in 60 seconds.
subscriptions.intro: Log a subscription provider in or out. Login opens the provider’s authorization page in a new tab; headless setups can paste the callback URL or code instead.
subscriptions.modelsContextInvalid: Enter a positive whole number of tokens for {model}.
subscriptions.modelsContextHint: Leave blank to follow the provider. The requested window is capped by the account’s advertised maximum; account pools use the smallest member window. This controls local history and compaction, not the API’s capacity.
subscriptions.proxyPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved password
subscriptions.accountsIndependent: Show an independent entry in the model picker
subscriptions.accountsPoolEnabled: Include in the LLM account pool
subscriptions.modelsPartialSave: Some reasoning defaults were saved. Remaining changes are still in the draft; retry to finish.
subscriptions.accountsModelsAutomatic: Allow all models, including future models
subscriptions.proxyUrlHint: HTTP or HTTPS proxy only (Clash/mihomo, v2rayN…); socks is not supported.
subscriptions.accountsIndependentHint: Independent LLM routes use only this account, with no fallback to another account. This does not isolate tools or the whole session.
subscriptions.modelsToolsHint: Changes apply only to sessions created after saving. Existing sessions keep their tools. Shared tools remain available if any supporting provider is enabled.
subscriptions.subscriptionDisplayNameHint: Used in the quota bar and subscription headings. Leave blank for the default.
subscriptions.accountsCatalogUnavailable: Model discovery is currently unavailable. Saved model selections are preserved.
subscriptions.modelsAutomatic: Automatically show all models, including new models
subscriptions.modelsHint: Configure model visibility, default reasoning effort, subagent speed, context and tools here; Save changes below submits them together with the account settings. Hidden models remain usable by existing sessions; tool changes apply to new sessions.
subscriptions.accountsHint: Choose which accounts serve pooled LLM requests. Pool exclusion applies only to LLM routing, not tools or session-wide isolation.
subscriptions.accountsNoModels: No models reported for this account.
subscriptions.proxyStatusNone: Plugin proxy disabled — using DSH network settings.
subscriptions.modelDisplayNameHint: Leave blank for the original name. Reasoning effort stays separate.
subscriptions.proxyEnabled: Route subscription requests through a proxy
subscriptions.proxyNote: On DSH v0.1.3-alpha.1, prefer the host HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY settings and leave this plugin proxy disabled. This optional override is retained for older hosts and subscription-only routing. Disabled or bypassed requests use DSH network settings; they are not necessarily direct. Applies to token exchange, model APIs, usage and tools. Browser OAuth follows the browser/system proxy.
subscriptions.proxyBypassHint: Comma-separated hostnames that skip this plugin proxy and use DSH network settings.
subscriptions.proxySaved: Saved — new requests use the updated network settings.
subscriptions.accountsModelsHint: Applies only to pooled LLM routing, not independent entries. An empty selection allows no models. Turning off pool participation keeps this selection for later.
subscriptions.modelsSubagentSpeedHint: Applies to subsequent subagent requests using this model, regardless of the parent model. Main conversations keep their own Speed setting. Fast requires model support.
subscriptions.proxyPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password
